text:
Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer has stepped down, nearly two years after leading the Labour Party to power in July 2024.

Facing mounting pressure from his own MPs and cabinet, Starmer resigned, making way for Andy Burnham to take over as the leader of the Labour Party and prime minister.

Explore our interactive guide below to learn more about the key figures who were in Starmer's cabinet.

The governing party's poll ratings have improved but they're only just ahead of Reform.

She says she stands by past comments that the interest charged on Plan 2 loans is "egregious".
